foundation: Intensional Martin-Lof Type Theory / Cubical Type Theory (--safe / --cubical)

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: thm zero = h0 ; thm (suc n) = hsucc n (thm n)
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Dependent clausal pattern matching and structural recursion verified by Agda's termination checker.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Write explicit clausal equations over constructors (`zero`, `suc n`), using `with` for intermediate scrutiny and `()` for empty patterns.
dialect_pitfalls: Dot patterns or `with`-abstractions failing when indices depend on non-variable terms
Non-structural recursion rejected without an explicit `WellFounded` accessibility witness
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: induction n with | zero => h0 | succ n' ih => hsucc

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: P? x : Dec (P x) | from-yes (P? x)
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: `Relation.Nullary.Decidable` (`Dec P` wrapping `does : Bool` and `proof : Reflects P does`) enabling proof by computation (`from-yes`).
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Use `from-yes (m <=? n)` for closed decidable goals and `with P? x` to split on `(yes p)` vs `(no ~p)`.
dialect_pitfalls: Computing with unary `Nat` decision procedures blows up on large numerals unless `Builtin.Nat` is used
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: by decide

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: prf lhs | rewrite eq1 | rewrite eq2 = refl
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: `rewrite eq` desugars into a `with`-abstraction over the LHS of `eq` followed by matching on `refl`.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Prefer explicit `cong` / `subst` or `≡-Reasoning` chains over deeply nested `rewrite` clauses.
dialect_pitfalls: `rewrite` fails with ill-typed `with`-abstraction when the goal's type depends on the rewritten subterm in a non-generalizable way
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: simp only [add_comm, mul_zero]

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: record IsGroup (G : Set) : Set where ... | {{_ : IsGroup G}}
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Explicit bundle/unbundled record hierarchies (`Algebra.Bundles`, `Algebra.Structures`) in `agda-stdlib` with optional `{{...}}` instance search.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Translate `agda-stdlib` bundled records (`Group c l`, `Ring c l`) to Lean 4 `[Group G]` / `[Ring R]` typeclass binders.
dialect_pitfalls: Opening multiple algebraic records simultaneously in Agda causes field name shadowing unless renamed
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: class Group (G : Type u) extends Monoid G, Inv G where ...

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: {! -m !} | solve 2 (\ x y -> lhs := rhs) refl
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Edit-time proof-term synthesis via Mimer/Agsy and reflective algebraic solvers (`Data.Nat.Solver`, `Algebra.Solver.Ring`).
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Replace reflective `+-*-Solver.solve` calls with `ring` / `omega` and Mimer-generated term trees with `aesop` / `grind` in Lean 4.
dialect_pitfalls: Agda has no runtime tactic engine; all search happens at edit time or via explicit reflection
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: aesop (add safe ...) or omega

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: begin a ≡⟨ h1 ⟩ b ≤⟨ h2 ⟩ c ∎
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Mixfix preorder and equational reasoning combinators from `Relation.Binary.Reasoning.Preorder`.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Translate `begin a ≡⟨ h1 ⟩ b ≤⟨ h2 ⟩ c ∎` directly to a Lean 4 `calc` block.
dialect_pitfalls: Mixing `≡⟨_⟩_` and `≤⟨_⟩_` requires opening the preorder reasoning module rather than propositional equality reasoning
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: calc a = b := h1 _ <= c := h2 _ < d := h3

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: record Setoid c l : Set (suc (c ⊔ l)) | data _/_ (A : Type) (R : A -> A -> Type)
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Explicit Bishop `Setoid` records in standard Agda (`--without-K`) or Higher Inductive Type quotients `A / R` in Cubical Agda (`--cubical`).
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Map Agda `Setoid` carriers + `≈` to Lean 4 `Setoid α` and `Quotient s`, or Cubical `elimProp`/`rec` to `Quotient.ind`/`Quotient.lift`.
dialect_pitfalls: Standard Agda lacks kernel quotients; every function on a Setoid carries an explicit `cong` field
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: Quot.sound (h : a ~ b) or Quotient.lift f h_resp

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: inv (step h) = h ; inv ()
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: First-class dependent pattern matching with built-in constructor disjointness (absurd pattern `()`) and injectivity.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Match directly on the indexed family constructor; impossible branches are discharged with `()`.
dialect_pitfalls: `--without-K` restricts pattern unification when self-equality of indices would require Streicher's K axiom
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: injection h with h1 h2 or contradiction

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: record GaloisConnection (P Q : Poset c l1 l2) : Set ...
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Order-theoretic records in `Relation.Binary.Lattice` and `Relation.Binary.Structures`.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Map Agda `GaloisConnection` records to Mathlib `GaloisConnection l u`.
dialect_pitfalls: Agda parameterizes posets by both underlying equality `≈` and order `≤` (`Poset c l1 l2`), whereas Lean 4 uses `PartialOrder α` on `=`
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: GaloisConnection l u meaning l a <= b <-> a <= u b

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: Σ[ x ∈ A ] P x | (x , px) | proj₁ s | proj₂ s
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Dependent pair record `Σ A B` with projections `proj₁` and `proj₂` and definitional eta-equality.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Map `Σ[ x ∈ A ] P x` where `P x : Prop` to `{x : A // P x}` (`Subtype`) in Lean 4, and where `P x : Type` to `(x : A) × P x` (`Sigma`).
dialect_pitfalls: In standard Agda without `Prop`, `proj₂` is proof-relevant (`Set`), so equality of `Σ A P` requires proving equality of the second component unless `P` is in `Prop` or `Irrelevant`
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: { x : A // P x } or <val, prop>

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: postulate em : ∀ {P : Set} → Dec P
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Constructive by default (`--safe` forbids `postulate`); classical reasoning is passed as an explicit module parameter or local hypothesis `em : ExcludedMiddle`.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Drop explicit `em : ExcludedMiddle` module parameters when porting to Lean 4 `Prop` theorems and use `Classical.em` / `by_cases` / `Classical.choose`.
dialect_pitfalls: Never translate an Agda `postulate` into a Lean `axiom`; use Lean's built-in `Classical.choice` (`noncomputable` + `Classical.choose`)
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: Classical.choose (h : exists x, P x) and Classical.choose_spec h

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: inv-preserved : ∀ {s s'} → Inv s → Step s s' → Inv s'
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Indexed reflexive-transitive closure `Star Step s s'` (`Relation.Binary.Construct.Closure.ReflexiveTransitive`) with inductive invariant preservation.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Map `Star Step` induction to `Relation.ReflTransGen.head_induction_on` and energy decrease `V s' <= V s` to `linarith`/`nlinarith` in Lean 4.
dialect_pitfalls: Manual polynomial energy inequalities in Agda require long `≤-Reasoning` chains that collapse to `nlinarith` or `positivity` in Lean 4
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: theorem invariant_step (s : State) (h_inv : Inv s) : Inv (step s) and V (step s) <= alpha * V s

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: solve 3 (\ a b c -> lhs := rhs) refl x y z
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Reflective semiring/ring equality solvers in `Data.Nat.Solver` and explicit monotonicity combinators for inequalities.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Collapse Agda `+-*-Solver` calls to `ring` and multi-line `+-mono-≤` trees to `omega` or `linarith`.
dialect_pitfalls: Agda lacks built-in `linarith` or `positivity`; inequality trees in Agda shrink by 90% when ported to Lean 4
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: by omega | by linarith [h1, h2] | by ring | by positivity

mechanisms.canonical_name: Numeric Coercions, Cast Normalization & Denominator Clearing
mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: rewrite +-pos m n | *-cancelʳ-≡ _ _ hnz
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Explicit constructor homomorphisms (`+-pos : (+ m) + (+ n) ≡ + (m + n)`) without implicit coercion search.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Replace explicit `+-pos` / `*-pos` rewrites with `push_cast` or `norm_cast` in Lean 4.
dialect_pitfalls: Agda terms contain explicit embedding constructors that disappear into `↑` coercions in Lean 4
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: push_cast; ring | zify [h_le] at *; omega | field_simp [hne]; ring

mechanisms.canonical_name: Well-Founded Recursion, Termination Measures & Functional Induction
mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: go : (x : A) -> Acc _<_ x -> B
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Structural recursion over an explicit accessibility proof `Acc _<_ x`.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Drop the explicit `Acc _<_ x` parameter when porting to Lean 4 and write a clean `termination_by` clause.
dialect_pitfalls: Agda functions parameterized by `Acc` carry the accessibility proof in their type signature unless wrapped
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: def f (x : alpha) : beta := ... termination_by measure x decreasing_by omega | fun_induction f x with ...

mechanisms.canonical_name: Measure Spaces, Lebesgue/Bochner Integration & Almost-Everywhere Filters
mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: record Measure (X : Set) : Set₁
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Constructive or postulated sigma-algebra records in specialized Agda libraries.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Lift Agda sigma-algebra definitions into Mathlib `[MeasurableSpace α]` and `(μ : Measure α)`.
dialect_pitfalls: Agda has no standard Bochner integration library; port abstract measure axioms to Mathlib `MeasureTheory`
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: ∫ x in s, f x ∂μ | ∫⁻ x, g x ∂μ | ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, P x | filter_upwards [h1, h2] with x hx1 hx2

mechanisms.canonical_name: Big Operators, Finite Sums/Products & Indexed Monoid Folding
mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: sum (map f (upTo n))
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: List or `Vec` folds over explicit enumeration lists (`upTo n`, `allFin n`).
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Convert list-based `sum (map f (allFin n))` into `∑ i : Fin n, f i` (`Fintype.sum`) in Lean 4.
dialect_pitfalls: List folds lack built-in `sum_bij` or `sum_comm` lemmas unless lifted to `Finset`
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: ∑ x ∈ s, f x | ∏ x ∈ s, f x | ∑ x ∈ s with P x, f x

mechanisms.canonical_name: Bitvectors, Machine Words, SWAR & Bit-Blasting Decision Procedures
mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: Word64 | Vec Bool 64
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Builtin `Word64` primitives or length-indexed `Vec Bool n` operations.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Port `Word64` / `Vec Bool 64` lemmas to `BitVec 64` and discharge with `by bv_decide`.
dialect_pitfalls: Agda lacks an integrated SAT bit-blaster with LRAT proof reconstruction
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: by bv_decide | by bv_omega | ext i hi; simp [BitVec.getLsbD]

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: funext (\ x -> ...) | cong f eq
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Theorem `funext h i x = h x i` in Cubical Agda (`--cubical`) or explicit postulate/Setoid pointwise equality `_≗_` in `--without-K` Agda.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Replace Agda pointwise function equality `f ≗ g` (`∀ x → f x ≡ g x`) with standard `f = g` proved via `funext x` in Lean 4.
dialect_pitfalls: Standard `--safe --without-K` Agda cannot prove `funext`, forcing libraries to thread `_≗_` congruence proofs that are unnecessary in Lean 4
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: ext x y | funext x | congr 1

mechanisms.canonical_name: Filters, Nets, Eventualities & Topological Limit Convergence
mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: ∀ ε → 0 < ε → Σ[ δ ∈ ℝ ] (0 < δ × ∀ x → dist x a < δ → dist (f x) l < ε)
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Direct `(ε, δ)` metric convergence predicates in Agda analysis libraries.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Refactor explicit `(ε, δ)` proofs into `Filter.Tendsto` and `fun_prop` when porting to Lean 4.
dialect_pitfalls: Translating `(ε, δ)` proofs literally into Mathlib misses 95% of `Filter.Tendsto` and `fun_prop` automation
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: Tendsto f (𝓝 x) (𝓝 y) | Tendsto u atTop (𝓝 l) | ∀ᶠ n in atTop, P n
